title: Le tocaba a alguien
desc: The suegra asks you, and not her own sons
setting: Doña Elena phones the house at nine on a Tuesday. Lucía is bathing the baby and you answer.

steps.speaker: Doña Elena
steps.es: Ah, es usted. Fíjese que tengo un problema con un papel del banco.
steps.en: Ah, it is you. The thing is I have a problem with a bank document.

options.en: Tell me, doña. What does the paper say?
options.feedback: You took it as yours before asking whether it was. That is the whole test and it is over in one line.

options.en: Do you want me to tell Lucía?
options.feedback: Helpful, and it hands the call back. She rang the house and got you, which is not an accident.
You have just passed your mother-in-law to somebody else in her own phone call.

steps.speaker: Doña Elena
steps.es: Es un trámite que no entiendo. ¿Usted podría acompañarme?
steps.en: It is paperwork I do not understand. Could you go with me?

options.es: Claro que sí. ¿Qué día le queda bien?
options.en: Of course. What day suits you?
options.feedback: Yes first, logistics second. Any gap between those two would have been the answer.

options.en: Yes, I will go when I can.
options.feedback: A yes with no day in it. Here that reads as a maybe.
He can. She did not ask him.

options.es: El jueves entonces. Yo paso por usted.
options.en: Thursday then. I will come by for you.
options.feedback: Fixed the day and took the travel off her. A woman of sixty-two should not be finding the bank on her own.
Agreed. She still has to get herself there.

options.es: Nos vemos allá a las ocho.
options.feedback: Meeting her at the door of a bank she does not understand is half a favour.

options.es: Hasta el jueves, doña. Que descanse.
options.feedback: Closed it the way you would close it with your own mother. That is what she rang to find out.
Adiós still sounds like forever. Hasta el jueves was right there.
You just agreed on Thursday. Now it is uncertain again.
